channel.title: Jon Maestas: Writing
channel.description: Building Player 1 in public, AI agents, and Athletic Intelligence.

item.title: Using Pólya's "How to Solve It" to Make AI Agents Better
item.description: How George Pólya's 1945 problem-solving framework — Understand, Plan, Execute, Look Back — improved my AI agents. Wired into Hermes, Pi, and Paseo for sharper outputs and fewer assumptions.

item.title: Training Sessions: Moving from Rep-by-Rep to Full-Session Intelligence
item.description: New Training Sessions feature records full workouts, auto-identifies reps, enables side-by-side comparison and session-level AI questions. Switched to TwelveLabs Pegasus for consistent video analysis.

item.title: Athletic Intelligence Means Knowing How to Get Better
item.description: Athletic Intelligence is knowing how to get better: seeing your movement, understanding the mistake, and knowing what to fix on the next rep.

item.title: The Player 1 Brand Architecture Funnel
item.description: We didn't create two brands to confuse the market — we created one hero product surrounded by an unbreakable funnel of lifestyle CTAs and defensive domains.

item.title: Why Your AI Needs a Loop (And a Skill)
item.description: The real magic of agentic AI: the AI iterates with itself so you don't have to. One prompt in, one answer out, zero back-and-forth with you.

item.title: My Newest App Feature Cost Less Than a Cup of Coffee
item.description: An accidental 4-second lag became Mirror Mode in Player 1 Training. Built and deployed for $1.50.

item.title: The 4-Second Delay That Became a Feature
item.description: An accidental projector lag in my barn turned into an instant replay feature for athletes.

item.title: Building in Public
item.description: Moving my public writing off social media and onto my own site.
